summary: ansible.builtin.oneline is the callback behind the -o/--one-line option; it is deprecated for instability and removed in 2.23.
questions: Is the ansible -o one-line output going away?
When is the oneline callback removed?

answer_card.title: oneline callback (deprecated)
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.oneline` powers `-o` / `--one-line`. It is **deprecated** due to long-term instability and is **removed in ansible-core 2.23**.
